stats.label: specialist tracks: Full Stack and Data

mern.label: Full Stack Web (MERN)
mern.blurb: MongoDB, Express, React and Node, on top of Git and HTML foundations. Trainees build and run web apps end to end.

data.label: Data Analytics with Python
data.blurb: Python for data analysis, from foundations up. Trainees clean, analyse and present real data.

solutions.name: Mama Salama
solutions.text: Emergency transport, labour tracking and birth savings plans for expectant mothers around Aitong.

solutions.name: Mara Smart Herd Tracker
solutions.text: Tracks herds by GPS, warns herders when animals stray past a set boundary, and gives advice in Maa, Kiswahili and English.

solutions.name: Mara Park Fee System
solutions.text: Online booking, QR tickets and M-Pesa payments for visitors at Sekenani Gate, with a live revenue dashboard.

solutions.name: Chama Digital
solutions.text: Lets a chama record savings, loans and repayments on a phone, and gives each member a credit score. In a pilot with the HPF Micro Enterprise Program.

timeline.title: Certified in graphic design
timeline.text: Every trainee completed the Learnio course and earned a certificate.

timeline.title: Bootcamp and core skills
timeline.text: Digital foundations with Power Learn Project Africa, with work saved on GitHub.

timeline.title: Specialisation
timeline.text: Each trainee chose Full Stack Web (MERN) or Data Analytics with Python.

timeline.title: HPF x PLP Hackathon
timeline.text: Teams pitched working apps to parents, leaders and partners at Community Day.

timeline.title: Capstone and Demo Day
timeline.text: Each trainee presents a capstone project.

timeline.title: Graduation
timeline.text: Cohort 1 graduates and is ready for work.
